fields.title: 📖 Īmān is word, deed and intention
fields.body:
🖋️ **Sufyān ath-Thawrī** said:

> ***“Īmān is word, deed and intention. It increases and decreases: it increases through obedience and decreases through sin.”***

> ***“Word, deed and intention are valid only when they agree with the Sunnah.”***

👉🏼 **Explanation**

This statement shows a clear principle of **Ahl as-Sunnah**: **Īmān** is not merely a word on the tongue, nor merely an inward claim in the heart. Rather, **word**, **deed** and **intention** belong to it.

It likewise becomes clear here: Īmān is not the same in all people. It grows stronger through **obedience** and is weakened through **sins**. For this reason the early Imāms did not join ʿaqīdah to empty claims, but to **following**, the **Sunnah** and righteous deed.

Especially important is the last sentence: even word, deed and intention need **agreement with the Sunnah**. A deed does not become right because a person finds it good, but because it agrees with the transmitted way.

🌙 **Conclusion:** Whoever wants to understand **Īmān** rightly must not separate it from the **Sunnah**. True Īmān shows itself in **word**, **deed**, **intention** and in holding fast to the way which the early Imāms transmitted.
